title: Angel Guardian commends fellow Palestinian Gazini Ganados for standing up for Gaza
summary: Angel Guardian commended fellow Filipino-Palestinian beauty queen Gazini Ganados for standing up for Palestine despite the potential consequences of speakilng out on the ongoing conflict in Gaza.…

blocks.text: Angel Guardian commended fellow Filipino-Palestinian beauty queen Gazini Ganados for standing up for Palestine despite the potential consequences of speakilng out on the ongoing conflict in Gaza. During the recent red-carpet premiere of her latest advocacy film, “Sa Tamang Oras at Panahon” (STOP), Guardian told Inquirer Entertainment that she admired Ganados for remaining vocal about her convictions. “I actually commend her for doing that. It’s not easy, di ba? Ang dami mong pwedeng makalaban na minsan ka-close mo. Na hindi mo alam na naniniwala sa iba.
